parts:
Dear Edmundo,

The key error message is right below the command library(QCA):
"htmltools 0.5.3 is loaded, but >= 0.5.4 is required"

You just need to reinstall / update package htmltools, and everything should work as usual.

I hope this helps,
Adrian
